title: Idle TUI spawns ~4 git processes per second (rev-parse/remote/worktree/stash/status), steady state
description:
Found 2026-10-01 by the THE-717 spawn-rate gate (exact strace execve counting) on its first real run.

`just bench-soak` (release, 40 worktrees in one fixture repo with dirty files and an `origin` remote, default layout, isolated state). With a 5-minute settle before the 60 s window — steady state, not startup catch-up — on main + THE-716 (container spawns already removed):

```
spawn rate: status=failed method=strace count=348 ceiling=0
  git -C <repo> rev-parse        x229
  git -C <repo> remote           x45
  git -C <repo> worktree         x24
  git -C <repo> stash            x12
  git -C <repo> status           x12
  git -C <repo> -c               x11
  git -C <repo> symbolic-ref / diff-index / for-each-ref / ls-files   (3-4 each)
  git -C <repo> log / show-ref   (1 each)
  (earlier runs also: a fetch via git-upload-pack, `git maintenance run --auto`, `git rev-list --objects --stdin`)
```

~4 git processes/second, indefinitely, on an idle TUI. CPU stays low (`cores_total ~0.04`) because each is short — which is why no other gate saw it (CPU ceiling passes, nothing leaks, a 20 ms /proc poll misses sub-20 ms processes).

## Not yet known
The offender grouping shows only argv[0] + first args, so `rev-parse x229` is not attributed to a code path. Candidates: the sidebar glyph scans (`hydrate.rs` tiers `is_dirty` scans by TTL with an active-worktree floor — at 40 worktrees, are background rows rescanned far more often than intended, and does each scan shell out instead of using gix?), periodic fetch / remote probing (`remote` + upload-pack fetch + `maintenance run --auto`), the merged-worktree sweep, the PR refresh, and `thegn_core::util::git_out`/`git_ok` callers (which THE-706's in-process spawn counter does NOT count).

## Acceptance criteria
- Every idle git spawn group in the soak is attributed to a call site.
- The idle soak's git spawn count is brought to 0, or each remaining source is named, justified, and on a long cadence.
- `just bench-soak` passes.
